paper_name: An Optimal Spin-Lock Priority Assignment Algorithm for Real-Time Multi-core Systems
paper_description: Generalizes FSLM for arbitrary spin-lock priorities per core, provides WCET analysis, and OSPA algorithm finding optimal fixed spin-lock priority per core maximizing schedulability.

formal_description.statement: FSLM: Blocked task spins at fixed priority pi per core, HP: pi = max prio, LP: pi = min prio.
WCET R_i(pi) = C_i + B_i(pi) + I_i(pi), B_i direct block, I_i interference depending on pi.

steps: B_i: if pi > holder, block longer
I_i: if pi < local, more interf
informal_sketch.pseudocode:
def wcrt_fslm(task_i, pi):
    B = compute_block(task_i, pi)
    I = compute_interf(task_i, pi)
    return task_i.C + B + I

formal_description.statement: OSPA finds pi* s.t. schedulable if exists, by testing all possible pi per core.

informal_sketch.intuition: Exhaustive but poly since finite prios.
steps: For each core, try all pi
